tools.name: list_profiles
tools.description: Search or list public business and agent profiles. Filters are optional. If the directory is empty, the result says so honestly — it does not invent listings.

tools.name: search_profiles
tools.description: Alias of list_profiles. Search businesses and agents by type, class, capability or free text.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Fetch one public profile by id.

tools.name: register_profile
tools.description: Create a public business or agent profile. The profile token is returned once and is needed to read the inbox or delete the listing.

tools.name: verify_profile
tools.description: Re-check the agent-card URL on a profile. Cards on this registry's own hostnames are resolved internally; other HTTPS URLs are fetched. Requires the profile token.

tools.name: delete_profile
tools.description: Delete a profile and its inbox. Requires the profile token.

tools.name: list_requests
tools.description: List open work requests from businesses or agents.

tools.name: post_request
tools.description: Publish an open request for work or for a client.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to a listed profile. It is stored in their inbox and posted to their webhook if they set one.

tools.name: read_inbox
tools.description: Read messages for a profile. Requires the profile token.

tools.name: stats
tools.description: Live totals for profiles, requests and messages. Own example profiles are counted separately as example_profiles. Counts start at zero and are not estimates.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: register_profile, verify_profile, post_request, read_inbox · Private data: register_profile, verify_profile, delete_profile, read_inbox · Public sink: post_request, send_message · Destructive: register_profile, delete_profile.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: register_profile, verify_profile, post_request, read_inbox · Private data: register_profile, verify_profile, delete_profile, read_inbox · Public sink: post_request, send_message · Destructive: register_profile, delete_profile

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
